cards.ex: The rehearsal was set for Friday, but we brought it forward to Wednesday so Mia could join us.
cards.exru: Репетицию назначили на пятницу, но мы перенесли её на среду, чтобы Мия смогла к нам присоединиться.
cards.note: В британском английском можно сказать bring the rehearsal forward или bring forward the rehearsal. С местоимением верно bring it forward. Ставить it после forward — ошибка. Новую дату указывают с to (to Wednesday), а на сколько сдвинули — с by (by two days). Put off означает отложить событие на потом.
cards.ru: перенести встречу или другое событие на более ранний срок

sources.evidence: The scheduling sense is mainly British. The entry gives both past forms and illustrates to with a new date and by with an interval.
sources.title: BRING SOMETHING FORWARD - Cambridge English Dictionary

sources.evidence: The scheduling sense is transitive. Both positions of a noun object are documented.
sources.title: BRING FORWARD definition and meaning | Collins English Dictionary

sources.evidence: An object pronoun goes between the verb and the particle of a separable phrasal verb.
sources.title: Phrasal verbs | LearnEnglish

sources.evidence: The British pronunciation of forward has a long first vowel and an unstressed second syllable.
sources.title: FORWARD | Pronunciation in English

sources.evidence: The scheduling sense of put off means postponing an event.
